# Course validator fixtures

One file per rule of `@tutors/course-rules`. Each holds a `broken` course that breaks only that rule (V002's also draws the V012 note that a pruned folder leaves behind) and the `fixed` form of the same course, as a map from path to file contents (`%PDF` stands in for a PDF, `PNG` for an image). The course-validation feature (Rules 0695-0700, V001-V006) the course-warnings feature (Rules 0710-0716, V007-V012 and `--fix`) and the rich-content feature (Rules 0724-0728, V013-V017; V017 checked with the reader's own Mermaid; V018 in the course-validation feature, Rules 0731-0732) assert the broken course reports the rule and the fixed course reports nothing; for V007 and V011, `--fix` turns the broken course into the fixed one byte for byte; and the generator conformance test builds both with `@tutors/tutors-gen-lib`.
